finding: Fit unweighted, the same estimator is six times worse on net-worth W1.
rule: Difference, unweighted vs candidate, net-worth W1; ratio within a factor of two (on ratio minus one).
value_2022: 829,158 vs 135,871; ratio 6.10; worse on 10/10 seeds
value_2025: 711,569 vs 165,931; ratio 4.29; worse on 10/10 seeds

finding: Unweighted is 2.5 times worse on debt W1.
rule: Difference, unweighted vs candidate, debt W1; ratio within a factor of two.
value_2022: 32,247 vs 13,001; ratio 2.48; worse on 10/10 seeds
value_2025: 18,537 vs 12,412; ratio 1.49; worse on 9/10 seeds

finding: Weighting is the largest of the three ablation effects on net-worth W1.
rule: Level: the unweighted ablation's mean paired delta is the largest of the three and positive.
value_2022: deltas: unweighted +693,287; ungated forest +98,496; unchained +22,735
value_2025: deltas: unweighted +545,638; ungated forest +29,485; unchained +37,883

finding: The ungated, unchained forest is worse than the candidate on net-worth W1 (1.7 times).
rule: Difference, plain_qrf vs candidate, net-worth W1; ratio within a factor of two.
value_2022: 234,367 vs 135,871; ratio 1.72; worse on 6/10 seeds
value_2025: 195,416 vs 165,931; ratio 1.18; worse on 6/10 seeds

finding: Removing chaining raises net-worth W1 by 17 percent.
rule: Difference, unchained vs candidate, net-worth W1; ratio within a factor of two.
value_2022: 158,606 vs 135,871; ratio 1.17; worse on 7/10 seeds
value_2025: 203,814 vs 165,931; ratio 1.23; worse on 8/10 seeds

finding: Hot deck nearly ties the candidate on debt W1.
rule: Tie, hot deck vs candidate, debt W1.
value_2022: 13,770 vs 13,001; ratio 1.06; hot deck worse on 5/10 seeds, better on 5/10
value_2025: 12,741 vs 12,412; ratio 1.03; hot deck worse on 5/10 seeds, better on 5/10

finding: Hot deck is 3.7 times worse on net-worth W1.
rule: Difference, hot deck vs candidate, net-worth W1; ratio within a factor of two.
value_2022: 509,013 vs 135,871; ratio 3.75; worse on 9/10 seeds
value_2025: 434,090 vs 165,931; ratio 2.62; worse on 9/10 seeds

finding: OLS is catastrophic on both targets.
rule: Level: OLS has the highest mean W1 on both targets, at least five times the candidate's.
value_2022: OLS W1 is 12.0x (debt) and 26.2x (net worth) the candidate's; highest on both
value_2025: OLS W1 is 10.1x (debt) and 16.3x (net worth) the candidate's; highest on both

finding: Linear quantile regression leaves 15 percent of the debt zero mass unaccounted for, against at most 2 percent for forest-based methods.
rule: Level: quantile regression's debt zero-share error is at least 0.10; the candidate, its ablations, and plain_qrf are each at most 0.03.
value_2022: quantile regression 0.151; forest-based 0.012 to 0.020
value_2025: quantile regression 0.157; forest-based 0.017 to 0.027

finding: The unconditional weighted marginal draw has the best pinball loss on both targets.
rule: Level: weighted_marginal has the lowest mean pinball loss on debt and on net worth.
value_2022: debt: marginal 48,277, candidate 49,201, lowest: marginal draw; networth: marginal 443,554, candidate 551,317, lowest: marginal draw
value_2025: debt: marginal 52,793, candidate 53,883, lowest: marginal draw; networth: marginal 531,502, candidate 691,571, lowest: marginal draw

finding: Gating shows no advantage on SCF debt zero share.
rule: Tie on seeds alone, plain_qrf vs candidate, debt zero-share error.
value_2022: ungated forest 0.018 vs candidate 0.020; forest worse on 4/10 seeds, better on 6/10
value_2025: ungated forest 0.027 vs candidate 0.017; forest worse on 8/10 seeds, better on 2/10

finding: The sampling floor behaves as designed.
rule: Level, both profiles: floor AUC within 2 floor sd of 0.5; energy below a fifth of every method's; coverage at least every method's; q99 ratio within 2 floor sd of 1.
value_2022: minimal: AUC 0.496, energy 0.009, coverage 0.987, q99 ratio 1.10; scale: AUC 0.499, energy 0.012, coverage 0.986, q99 ratio 1.10
value_2025: minimal: AUC 0.506, energy 0.010, coverage 0.991, q99 ratio 0.99; scale: AUC 0.510, energy 0.013, coverage 0.990, q99 ratio 0.99

finding: The unweighted ablation ties the candidate on energy distance, coverage, and C2ST AUC in both profiles.
rule: Six ties, unweighted vs candidate; all must be met.
value_2022: largest gap 0.72 floor sd (coverage, scale: 0.971 vs 0.969); 6/6 ties met
value_2025: largest gap 1.12 floor sd (AUC, scale: 0.735 vs 0.757); 5/6 ties met

finding: Its imputed net-worth q99 is about twice the holdout's (1.93 and 2.25).

value_2025: minimal: 1.79 vs candidate 0.64 (7.5 floor sd; 10/10 seeds); scale: 1.78 vs candidate 0.63 (7.5 floor sd; 10/10 seeds)

finding: Its tail W1/sd is five times the candidate's.

value_2025: minimal: 0.125 vs 0.040, ratio 3.12 (9/10 seeds); scale: 0.081 vs 0.048, ratio 1.69 (8/10 seeds)

finding: With two targets the unchained ablation is indistinguishable from the candidate.
rule: Tie, unchained vs candidate, C2ST AUC, minimal profile.
value_2022: 0.742 vs 0.732; gap 0.40 floor sd
value_2025: 0.727 vs 0.719; gap 0.36 floor sd

value_2025: 0.806 vs 0.757; gap +0.049 (2.54 floor sd); higher on 9/10 seeds

value_2025: largest gap 2.74 floor sd (W1/sd, scale: 0.062 vs 0.048); 3/4 ties met

finding: The ungated forest loses 5.6 AUC points at scale.

value_2025: 0.816 vs 0.757; gap +0.059 (3.03 floor sd); higher on 9/10 seeds

finding: At scale the classifier separates the unconditional marginal draw almost perfectly (AUC 0.97 against the candidate's 0.76).

value_2025: 0.968 vs 0.757; gap +0.211 (10.90 floor sd); higher on 10/10 seeds

value_2025: 0.845 (minimal) to 0.968 (scale): rise +0.123

value_2025: minimal: candidate 0.719, lowest baseline 0.731; scale: candidate 0.757, lowest baseline 0.754

value_2025: largest gap 1.19 floor sd (energy, scale: 0.089 vs 0.085); 3/4 ties met

value_2025: largest gap 0.51 floor sd (AUC, minimal: 0.731 vs 0.719); 2/2 ties met
